newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae gains on rising profit optimism.
newsitem.headline: Sonae gains on rising profit optimism.

text.p: Investor optimism that wood products group Sonae Industria will turn in higher profits than predicted for 1996 was lifting the stock price 2.75 percent to 1,456 escudos on Tuesday.
The share was off a 1,480 escudo high but traders still saw 1,500 as the target.
Sonae said last September it expected a net profit, after minorities, of 400 million escudos this year, down from 1.1 billion in 1995.
"(But) the last quarter has gone much better than Sonae Industria expected," said one analyst.
Analysts said that the market had been slow to react to signs of an improvement in the industrial environment. The group's Spanish subsidiary Tafisa has gained 25 percent since last November 22.
